rationale: The user asked to update their address and to get the price of the cheapest available t‑shirt, and whether the agent could place the order. The agent did not authenticate the user, did not retrieve or update any address, did not provide pricing or product info, did not confirm any order‑changing action, and made no tool calls. It simply offered a friendly message. This fails the policy’s requirements to authenticate, act only on the user’s orders with confirmation, and provide correct final information. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
